description: This file defines the 'TodoRepository' class which acts as an abstraction layer for data operations related to to-do tasks and categories, interfacing with the database via DAOs.

classes.name: TodoRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing tasks and categories, providing suspend functions for database operations.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all category entities from the database.

methods.name: ensureCategoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a category with the specified name exists; if not, inserts it and returns the CategoryEntity.

methods.name: searchAndFilterTasks
methods.description: Searches and filters tasks based on a query string and optional category ID.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Inserts a new task into the database.

methods.name: getTaskById
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID.

methods.name: getDueTasksBy
methods.description: Retrieves tasks due before a specified time.
